doc: docs/optimistic-merge.md. Read by scripts/audit_optimistic_merge.py. Every exemption names its class, reason, owner and a review date; one past its review date stops applying and the repository is audited again.

pin_floor.note: A red-main caller or main-red-gate pin is conformant when it is this commit or a descendant of it. Move the floor forward when a fix every caller needs lands.

no-build.meaning: Nothing to build or deploy (brand, profile, policy pages, shared config); also frozen open-source repositories.

frozen-legacy.meaning: A shipped original kept as it is; no change flows through its queue.

hands-off.meaning: A delivered customer repository or a protected original. Its files are never read.

suite-is-gate.meaning: Whole pull-request CI is short enough (p90 about 5 minutes or less) that the merge gate already is the full suite, so there is no post-merge verification to add. The merge queue and a required check still must exist, and `verified` is never one.

on-red-notify.meaning: Declares an on_red the builder App does not back yet; the handler runs as notify until the App reaches the organization.

exemptions.reason: Measured pull-request CI p90 at or under about 5 minutes (jobs 1.2 minutes or less in big2-tycoon and cubeage-studio; the wall time is runner wait, not suite length). cubeage-native-sdk gates on release acceptance checks. cubeage-cs-agent: recheck at 20 runs.
Nothing to build or deploy: assets, policy pages, shared configuration, SDK mirrors and frozen open-source repositories.
Shipped legacy originals, kept as they are; the faithful remakes carry the new pipeline.
Delivered customer repository (bgca), protected original (hk-mahjong-tycoon) and the hosted stopgap (openclaw-sylphx): no work unless their owner asks.
Declare on_red revert, but the builder App does not reach the Cubeage organization, so the handler runs as notify (tenant organizations lack the writer App).
